name: koha-plugin-ums-gentle-nudge-multi
description: UMS Gentle nudge plugin for multi-branch systems

scripts.preversion: sed -i -e "s/^our \$VERSION .*/our \$VERSION         = \"$npm_new_version\";/" Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/UMSGentleNudge.pm; perl scripts/stamp-changelog.pl v$npm_new_version; git add -u; rm -f Koha/Plugin/Com/ByWaterSolutions/UMSGentleNudge.pm-e
scripts.postversion: perl scripts/open-next-changelog.pl v$npm_package_version; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit -m 'Open next development cycle'

author: Lisette Scheer <lisette@bywatersolutions.com>
